name: trigger
description: An event trigger management tool that creates, inspects, updates, and deletes reactive event monitors to execute one-time automated skills immediately upon external events. Use whenever you need to configure or manage reactive triggers for system events (such as file creation or modification). Use this to achieve immediate event-driven autonomy without continuous manual polling.

trigger_name.description: Name of the trigger to create, from trigger_search, e.g. filesystem_new_file

task.description: Task to run when triggered, will be turned into a Skill

config.description: Plugin-specific config for the trigger, e.g. {"watch_path": "storage/files/watch"}

trigger_id.description: ID of the trigger for get/delete/update
